UNLEASH THE AURORA

Exclusive to the AMP Holo is the award-winning HoloBlack design embracing an iridescent holographic finish that exudes an aurora like glow. The design captivates your eyes with the RGB lighting underneath and even with the lights off, the HoloBlack design itself is a showcase.

...

- ENHANCED AIRFLOW

 The ZOTAC GAMING graphics card enhances cooling performance by utilizing an 11-blade fan design. The curved blades optimized for static pressure can increase airflow by up to 10%*. The ZOTAC GAMING AMP Extreme Holo feature a larger set of fans with triple 100mm fans for maximum airflow dynamics. *when compared to the previous generation design at the same RPM

AMP Holo model is a proud winner of Red Dot Design Award for outstanding achievement in Product Design.

MORE RESILIENT

The design of ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3080 12GB Series underlines durability from front to back with a full-board metal frontplate and backplate to increase the overall card rigidity and structural integrity. The AMP Extreme Holo features an additional retention mount to reinforce contact.
